import csv,json
from decimal import Decimal
source = "/workspace/scratch/73714494ad2f/forge-protocol-comparison-20261003/materials/expenses.csv"
json_path = "/workspace/scratch/73714494ad2f/forge-protocol-comparison-20261003/project/B2/artifacts/summary.json"
md_path = "/workspace/scratch/73714494ad2f/forge-protocol-comparison-20261003/project/B2/artifacts/summary_zh.md"
grouped = {}
with open(source, encoding="utf-8", newline="") as source_file:
    for row in csv.DictReader(source_file):
        fen_decimal = Decimal(row["amount_yuan"]) * Decimal(100)
        if fen_decimal != fen_decimal.to_integral_value():
            raise ValueError("amount does not convert to an integer fen")
        entry = grouped.setdefault(row["category"], {"row_count": 0, "total_fen": 0, "ids": []})
        entry["row_count"] += 1
        entry["total_fen"] += int(fen_decimal)
        entry["ids"].append(row["id"])
result = {category: grouped[category] for category in sorted(grouped)}
with open(json_path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as output_file:
    json.dump(result, output_file, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
    output_file.write("\n")
lines = ["# 费用分类汇总", "", "金额以 Decimal 按 1 元 = 100 分精确换算；ID 按 CSV 原始行序排列。", "", "| 类别 | 行数 | 合计（分） | 来源 ID |", "| --- | ---: | ---: | --- |"]
for category, entry in result.items():
    lines.append("| {} | {} | {} | {} |".format(category, entry["row_count"], entry["total_fen"], ", ".join(entry["ids"])))
with open(md_path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as output_file:
    output_file.write("\n".join(lines) + "\n")
print(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True))
